superagent is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2016 to 2025.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2).

Most recently: [microcrawler-js](@/work/microcrawler-js.md): Scrapping made easy; [microcrawler-ng](@/work/microcrawler-ng.md): Microcrawler.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses superagent: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links superagent to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
